[Pedagogy review · High priority · opening-review · pf-aa0adbcdce]
At p6-example-demonstration: Add four short opening-review items using a bag containing 4 red and 2 blue counters: (1) Find P(red on the first draw). Answer: 4/6. (2) After drawing red without replacement, find P(red next) and P(blue next). Answers: 3/5 and 2/5. (3) Find P(red then blue) without replacement. Answer: (4/6)(2/5)=4/15. (4) Find P(exactly one red in two draws without replacement), showing both orders. Answer: (4/6)(2/5)+(2/6)(4/5)=8/15. Keep the review within one page.
